QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] The Truth of Magatia
QuestInfo.0: You decide to let Phyllia know of the truth. The rest is up to the people of Magatia, and you should report to the Alliance what happened so far.
QuestInfo.1: The last thing remaining after revealing the truth of Magatia and the tragedy of the missing alchemist is to report the truth to the Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: After hearing about the truth behind Magatia, Neinheart lamented the fate of Dr. De Lang and worried about the alchemists. He thanked you and said that the Alliance will keep a close eye on Magatia since it was built upon the research of the Black Mage.

0.0: I've delivered Dr. De Lang's Notes to Phyllia and let her know of the truth. Since I found clues related to the Black Mage at a place I wasn't expecting, I should probably report it to the Alliance as well.
0.1: Shall I head to Ereve?\r\n#b(Accept to move to the next quest location.)#k

1.0: What is it? Give your report.

yes.0: ...So, Magatia was built upon the research of the Black Mage... I've heard this before, but always believed it to be a baseless rumor. But if it were true, it would follow that the alchemists would do all they could to suppress that truth.
yes.1: I suppose Dr. De Lang has achieved his dream, though it's a somewhat hollow victory he can't remember it... Since Phyllia knows about the truth, I suppose his honor would be restored at the very least.
yes.2: Even if Magatia was built upon harrowing ideas, the discoveries the alchemists have given Maple World were undoubtably their own. That said, with the truth coming to light, the Alliance will have to keep a close eye on them.
yes.3: The rest is up to the people of Magatia. In any case, thank you for everything you've done for them.
